Subject: Partner support request — Spark Series cohort credits

Hi Priyom,

Thanks for taking a look — I run partnerships at EventsGrove and we're running a three-session webinar series (Spark Series) the week of Aug 11. Acme Analytics is sponsoring a partner cohort of ~250 practitioners who will get an accelerated onboarding flow.

Quick ask: can Redwood provide a batch of "starter access" credits we can distribute to that cohort? Ideally:
- 500 starter credits total (2 credits per attendee)
- Codes delivered as a CSV with code + expiry (we'll insert into our registration flow)
- Ability to restrict redemption to brand-new accounts only

Attached is a short scope doc that outlines the cohort profile and distribution timeline (spark_series_scope.pdf). Event date is Aug 12; we need codes in-hand by Aug 6 to finalize the registration emails.

If there's a cost or procurement step, please flag and we can loop in Acme procurement (Susan copied). Happy to jump on a 20-min call if that's easier.

Thanks,
Olivia Chen
Head of Partnerships, EventsGrove
olivia@eventsgrove.io
(415) 555-0123

Quick confirmation items so I can get an internal sign-off: 
- Total requested: 500 starter credits (we interpret as promo codes that grant limited free tokens / access)
- Distribution window: codes must be created and delivered by Aug 6
- Restrict to new accounts only — confirm we should block redemption for existing Redwood accounts

I'll loop in Marissa (budget) and Jonas (ops) for approval and implementation. Irene, can you check whether any compliance constraints apply for issuing cohort codes (KYC/enterprise exclusions)?

Jonas — if you can prepare the CSV template and the code-generation ETA, that helps. We may want to stagger release (200 immediately, 300 conditional on engagement) depending on budget direction.

Olivia — if Acme needs a short MSA addendum or billing acknowledgement, note that in your reply so we can coordinate procurement.

Thanks,

Rationale: controls cost while giving the partner enough runway to see early success.

- Use the billing code PR-AUG25 for cost reporting.
- Jon: please format the CSV like the attached sample (sample-access-codes.csv) with columns: code, expires_at, max_tokens, note.
- We'll tag the HubSpot deal (DEAL-7890) with "Spark Series promo" and note bundle assignment.

If Acme pushes back, we can move to 400 immediate credits but need an exec ok for the difference. Priyom, you have discretionary sign-off up to 350 — if you want to approve 400, escalate to me.
